text:
ana: FYI I spotted a subtle compatibility issue between runtime 7.0 and SDK 7.1.2 for batched streaming responses. It manifests as truncated final tokens when batch_size >= 8 and seq_len > 3k. Proposing a short unpin in ap-south-1 to avoid customer impact while we ship a patch.

mike: Can you quantify the impact? Is this 5xx, incorrect output, or just cut-off streaming?

ana: Mostly cut-off streaming (clients get final CRLF dropped). No 5xx. Seen in ~0.2% of large-batch requests during peak overlap tests. Repro with: `tests/streaming/repro_batch_drop --batch 8 --len 3500`.

lucy: Ops suggestion: staged unpin in ap-south-1 with canary -> 5/25/100. Also add a runtime compatibility note for SDK >=7.1.2 marking it as "partial incompatibility" for batched streams.

sre-bot: (bot) New change window scheduled: unpin-window-4923 at 2026-03-28T03:00Z. Use `/deploybot unpin` to begin.

ana: Proposed runbook:
1) `/deploybot unpin runtime=7.0 region=ap-south-1 actor=ana reason="streaming-truncate-batch"`
2) start canary at 5% (r-apso-431) with smoke eval: `scripts/eval_stream_hash --from=6.9.8 --to=7.0 --suite=batches --threshold=0.005`
3) watch stream-complete metric, p50/p99 latency, and sdk-client drop_count for 20m windows
4) ramp to 25% then 100% if green; rollback path: pin back to 6.9.8 and open rollback ticket with audit id

mike: Also flag rollout notes: customers using streaming + batching should pin SDK to <=7.1.1 or upgrade to the patched SDK when available. We'll add a compatibility badge in the console.

ops: Ready to apply routing. Will only affect ap-south-1 runtime pool. Need final approval to execute. Also will attach sticky pin exceptions for verified enterprise customers who requested immediate preservation of 7.0.

deploybot: (bot) Command queued: `/deploybot unpin runtime=7.0 region=ap-south-1 actor=ana window=unpin-window-4923` - queued.

lucy: One more: add an automated smoke that compares full-stream checksums to ensure no silent truncation: `stream_checksum --svc=hosted-api --samples=500` as a gate at each ramp stage.

ana: Executing now. Canary at 5% applied (routing r-apso-431). Anchor created anchor-4923-aa expiring in 24h.

sre-bot: (bot) Canary created: canary-4923 mapping service=hosted-api -> runtime=6.9.8 at 5%.

ops: Observability update (25m): stream-complete metric improved from 99.78% -> 99.99% in canary. stream_checksum diffs under threshold. Proceeding to 25%.

mike: Support side: notify #support-enterprise and attach steps for customers who hit truncation: temporary SDK pin `pip install redwood-sdk==7.1.1` and a client-side backoff to smaller batch sizes.

ana: Engineering note: root cause likely around chunked encoding + kv-cache flush boundary in the new streaming codepath. We'll prioritize a hotfix 7.0.1 with a flush-sentinel and a small SDK compatibility patch. ETA 36h.

lucy: Rolling to 100% after 40m green checks. Leaving anchor for 24h while patches land. If any customer complaints exceed 3 in a 1h window, rollback immediately.

deploybot: (bot) Anchor anchor-4923-aa will expire at 2026-03-29T03:00Z unless extended. To extend: `/deploybot anchor extend anchor-4923-aa duration=24h`. Audit id audit-4923-zz recorded.

ops: 100% rollout completed at 03:55Z. No regressions observed so far. Will follow up with release note and compatibility matrix update.

ana: Thanks team. I'll post links to PRs for runtime 7.0.1 and SDK 7.1.3 in this thread when ready and follow up with a short postmortem + unpin schedule.

deploybot: (bot) Change window unpin-window-4923 closed.
